item.title: Trialer For DON'T PUSH THAT Unleashes a $1,500 Sci-Fi Comedy About Pressing The Worst Button Ever
item.description: There’s something special about scrappy indie sci-fi, especially when it leans into absurdity and just goes for it. A trailer has landed for Don’t Push That!, a silly, super low-budget sci-fi comedy that proves you don’t need a massive budget to come up with a clever hook and have some fun blowing up reality.The film comes from filmmaker Durden Godfrey, working out of Jacksonville, Florida, and it was made on an impressively tiny budget of just $1,500. That DIY energy is baked into the concept.
